definitions.gloss: closer; relief pitcher who finishes the game (baseball)
definitions.explanation: A relief pitcher brought in to protect a narrow lead and record the final outs, usually in the ninth inning; an English loanword.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はチームのクローザーだ。
クローザーが{九回|きゅうかい}を{抑|おさ}えた。
examples.english: The closer shut down the ninth inning.

examples.japanese: {信頼|しんらい}できるクローザーがいると{試合|しあい}を{有利|ゆうり}に{進|すす}められる。
examples.english: Having a reliable closer lets you play the game to your advantage.

notes:
An English loanword for the relief pitcher who finishes a close game. The native equivalent is {抑|おさ}え or {抑|おさ}えの{投手|とうしゅ}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {抑|おさ}え: closer — the native Japanese term for the same role
- {中継|なかつ}ぎ: middle reliever — pitches the middle innings before the closer
